manifest.name: dsh-mem0
manifest.description: Mem0 long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: managed Platform, self-hosted server or local OSS, with a visual settings page, automatic recall/capture, editable memory summary, token budgets and weekly memory hygiene.
manifest.author: Light Cheng (https://github.com/light-cheng)

bundle.text:
# DSH Mem0 bundle patch.
#
# The plugin supports three backends through its Config:
#   platform — Mem0 Platform API key (managed cloud / on-prem)
#   server   — a self-hosted Mem0 REST server
#   oss      — a local Mem0 OSS Python sidecar
#
# Defaults use `backend: auto`: platform if an API key is configured (config,
# DSH credentials or environment), server when a custom baseUrl is set,
# otherwise OSS when a local `~/.dsh/mem0/oss.json` (or a legacy location, see
# lib/legacy-paths.js) exists, otherwise platform. Configure the row in the
# profile patch layer.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-mem0
      name: 'dsh-mem0'

readme.text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A universal Mem0 long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Repository: Three backends are supported:

- **Mem0 Platform**: the managed Mem0 API; only an API key is required, and it is the best fit for most users.
- **Self-hosted server**: connect to your own Mem0 REST service.
- **OSS Python sidecar**: reuse a local Mem0 Python SDK / Qdrant / embedding setup, suitable for local bge-m3, Qdrant and similar self-hosted environments.

- **Automatic recall**: on every turn, the latest real user message is used to search for related memories, injected into the model context as a `<mem0-relevant-memories>` data block. A failed or timed-out search never blocks the model request.
- **Automatic capture and filtering**: after a turn completes normally, the turn's user messages and the final assistant reply (not the intermediate narration between tool calls) are handed to Mem0 for fact extraction and storage, so long tool-heavy turns are still captured; interrupted, failed or rejected turns are not saved. The default heuristic filter skips greetings, short acknowledgements and command-only turns to reduce low-value memories.
- **Editable memory summary**: a structured summary is derived from stored memories, ranked by pinned/importance metadata and then freshness (newer facts first, decaying over roughly 90 days; text length only breaks ties), and injected before relevant memories. It has its own token budget, can be edited directly in the settings page, and can be read or rewritten by the agent through `mem0_profile_get` / `mem0_profile_update` / `mem0_profile_reset`. Manual edits survive weekly hygiene; **Rebuild from

After installation, open **Plugins** in the DSH sidebar and open **Mem0 Memory** under **Installed plugins**. You can choose a backend, inspect live connection status and save settings directly in the bundle detail page:

Each backend has its own fields and guidance:

The **Test connection** button calls the same read-only health check as `mem0_status`, showing the current backend, collection, Python/Mem0/Qdrant/Embedder status, and never the API key.

**Memory summary** is the editable summary injected before relevant memories. It is shown as structured sections; use **Edit summary** to edit it and **Rebuild from memories** to regenerate it from the store. Manual edits survive weekly hygiene.

**Memory activity** records the latest automatic capture and recall results; **Recent memories** reads the backend directly and shows real memory text, ID and time. This makes it clear whether automatic capture actually worked. A capture that ran but wrote nothing (no memory added, updated or deleted) shows a grey **Nothing new** badge instead of the green **Saved**, and the composer status says **Nothing new to remember**. Platform and server answers that report no counts keep the **Saved** badge.

**View all memories** opens the **Memory library**, where every memory stored for the current user can be searched by content or ID. Memories this plugin wrote (`metadata.source = "dsh"`) have a **Delete** button. It first shows the memory's full text and ID and asks for confirmation; only then is that one memory deleted, its cached translation dropped and the list reloaded. Memories written by other apps or for another Mem0 user have no button, and the plugin's route (`DELETE /dsh-mem0/gui/memories?id=…`) refuses them with HTTP 403 and the reason. There is no bulk delete, clear-all or delete-by-filter. **Last recalled memories** shows the texts, IDs, count and latency of the most recent automatic recall:
The **Memory summary** card shows the editable, structured summary that is injected before relevant memories. Save a manual version or rebuild it from the store:

The **Memory maintenance** section lets you adjust the memory summary budget, recall budget, storage limits and hygiene interval, and shows the last/next hygiene time, the latest hygiene report (scanned, duplicates, pruned, deleted, failed, run time and trigger) and current memory size. **Run hygiene now** first computes a preview and asks you to confirm "delete N memories" before removing duplicates and over-budget memories written by this plugin; a manually edited memory summary is preserved.

The dot-matrix globe below the chat composer stays still while idle, rolls along a tilted direction while recording, and turns light blue and keeps rolling on success. The rolling animation uses a 3D projection, so the dot sphere keeps a circular silhouette and does not squash or deform; it stays still when the system requests reduced motion.

The actual status bar at the bottom of a conversation (cropped):

When **Test connection** succeeds, the status card shows a green **Connected** chip:

The UI follows DSH's language setting. When `translateMemories` is on (off by default, see [Privacy and data](#privacy-and-data)), the visible memory text, memory summary and recall preview are translated into the page language with the current DSH model; otherwise, or when translation is unavailable, the original text is shown. A Chinese screenshot is available in the [Chinese README](README.zh-CN.md).

The **Memory maintenance** section separates several budgets that are easy to confuse:

- **Memory summary budget**: upper bound for the `<mem0-user-profile>` block, 1375 tokens by default.
- **Recall memory budget**: upper bound for the `<mem0-relevant-memories>` block, 2200 tokens by default.
- **Storage limits**: maximum number of memories (default 500) and estimated tokens (default 20000) retained after hygiene.

Hygiene runs every 7 days by default and can be set to 1–90 days. It runs once at plugin startup if due, then checks hourly. It deletes only duplicates and the oldest over-budget memories, and only among memories this plugin wrote (`metadata.source: "dsh"`, set by auto-capture and `mem0_add`). Memories written by other apps under the same `userId` are read into the summary but never deleted and do not count toward the storage limits. Until you have confirmed one manual **Run hygiene now**, automatic passes are dry runs: they write a report marked "Preview, nothing deleted" listing what would be deleted, and delete nothing. Each pass deletes at most 100 memories. The profile and hygiene history are stored in the current DSH profile's `dsh-mem0/maintenance.json`, not written back to Mem0. The latest report stays visible in the Memory maintenance card, including the scanned, duplicate, pruned, deleted and failed counts, run time and trigger; a manual **Run hygiene now** also returns the same counts.

The generated memory summary uses local deterministic logic without extra model calls. Facts are grouped into sections by topic. You can edit it at any time; manual edits are stored in `maintenance.json` and are not overwritten by hygiene. Use **Rebuild from memories** to return to the generated version. Section headings follow the dominant language of the memories (Chinese when most facts are Chinese, English otherwise).

To keep DeepSeek's prefix cache warm, the summary is a system-prompt section (`plugin:dsh-mem0:profile`) that changes only when the stored summary changes. The per-turn `<mem0-relevant-memories>` block is a runtime context (`mem0:recall`), which DSH appends next to the latest user message, so it never rewrites earlier history.

Context-management plugins (for example dsh-strata) can recognise what DSH-Mem0 injects by these names and tags. They are stable across releases; changing any of them is a breaking change, and `test/interop-contract.test.js` guards them.

| What | Where it goes | Name | Text starts / ends with | Changes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Memory summary | system-prompt section | `plugin:dsh-mem0:profile` | `<mem0-user-profile>` … `</mem0-user-profile>` | only when the stored summary changes |
| Recalled memories | runtime context, always last | `mem0:recall` | `<mem0-relevant-memories>` … `</mem0-relevant-memories>` | usually every turn |

- DSH joins all runtime contexts into one snapshot and appends it to history as a user-role message with `source.kind: "runtime-context"` whenever the joined text changes. Older snapshots stay in history, so their recall blocks are stale: a context plugin can trim or drop them without a model summary and without keeping the original, because Mem0 can recall again at any time. The newest snapshot should be left alone.
- The snapshot is not user input. Automatic capture only reads `user/message` events whose source is `user`, so recall blocks are never captured back into Mem0.
- Capture runs on `turn/end` from the text DSH-Mem0 buffered from that turn's events (the user messages and the final assistant reply). It does not read session history or tool output, so trimming history at the end of a turn, before or after capture, does not change what is saved.
- Memory text in a recall block has forged block tags removed, so each block contains exactly one opening and one closing tag.
With [dsh-strata](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lightcheng/dsh-strata) installed, the two plugins follow a shared contract:

- **Shared recall budget.** Before each recall, DSH-Mem0 asks Strata's optional `strataBudget` service how many tokens the recall block may use this turn: the full `memoryBudgetTokens` normally, half once the context passes 65% (`tight`), and at most 512 tokens past 75% (`critical`). An allowance of 0 skips recall for that turn. The block is fitted with Strata's token counter, the same one its thresholds use. Without Strata, or if the service fails or returns something unusable, recall uses `memoryBudgetTokens` as before. The memory summary is never shrunk per turn: it sits in the cached system prompt, and changing it every turn would cost more than it saves. `mem0_status` and the Recent activity card show the last budget, e.g. `recall budget 1100 / 2200 (strata: tight)`.
- **Fold summaries as a memory source (`captureStrataFolds`, off by default).** When it is on, together with automatic capture, each first-level fold summary that Strata lands (`strata/fold-landed`, tier 1 only, main-agent sessions only) is redacted and saved through the same capture queue, with metadata `source: "dsh"`, `via: "dsh-strata"`, `fold`, `tier` and `session_id`, so hygiene treats it like any other capt

```text
DSH Agent
  ├─ system-prompt/assemble ──┐
  ├─ session/event            ├─> Node plugin (index.js + lib/)
  ├─ mem0_* tools            ─┘        │

Install this directory through the DSH Plugin Manager (development/local install):

```text
plugin_manager action: install_bundle
target: <absolute path to this directory>
```

Or use the DSH CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:"$(pwd)"
```

After the package is published to npm, install it by package name:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-mem0
```

If DSH reports `restart-required`, restart DSH before verifying.

> A local `link:` install makes DSH show the absolute checkout path under **Code source** in the plugin detail page. That is install metadata from the local profile, not part of the package. `npm pack` and registry installs contain no local paths; installing `dsh-mem0` from npm shows the package source instead. The published screenshots are captured so that this local-only row is not included.

After installation, configure it visually in **Plugins → Mem0 Memory** in the DSH sidebar (recommended); you can also write the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. Full YAML example:

```yaml
- id: dsh-mem0
  name: dsh-mem0
  config:
    backend: platform

```yaml
config:
  backend: platform
  apiKey: "your-platform-api-key"
  userId: "your-user-id"

The key does not have to be in the plugin config. Recommended: store it in DSH credentials (for example `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`), so it never appears in the profile config:

```yaml
version: 1
refs:
  MEM0_API_KEY: m0-your-key
```

and refer to it by name (this is the default):

```yaml
config:
  backend: platform
  apiKeyEnv: MEM0_API_KEY
```

Lookup order: a literal `apiKey` in the config, then DSH credentials for the name in `apiKeyEnv` (the store first, then the launching environment and `.env` files), then the environment variable of that name. With credentials, a rotated key applies on the next request without a restart. `mem0_status` reports where the key came from (`key source: config`, `credentials`, `env` or `none`), never the key.

> **Note on `backend: auto`:** if `MEM0_API_KEY` (or the name in `apiKeyEnv`) is stored in DSH credentials or set in DSH's environment, `auto` picks the cloud Platform even when a local OSS config exists. `mem0_status` and the settings page show why the backend was chosen ("backend choice"). Set `backend` explicitly if you want a specific one.

```yaml
config:
  backend: server
  baseUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:8888"
  authType: apiKey

`authType` supports `apiKey` (`X-API-Key`), `bearer`, `token` and `none` (for local services with `AUTH_DISABLED=true`).

First prepare a Mem0 OSS config file, for example `~/.dsh/mem0/oss.json`; see [examples/oss-config.example.json](examples/oss-config.example.json).

```yaml
config:
  backend: oss
  pythonPath: "~/.dsh/mem0/venv/bin/python"
  mem0ConfigPath: "~/.dsh/mem0/oss.json"

The Python environment needs:

```bash
python3 -m venv ~/.dsh/mem0/venv
~/.dsh/mem0/venv/bin/pip install "mem0ai>=2.0.10,<3" qdrant-client openai
```

This version **does not silently install** Python or Qdrant when the plugin loads, and does not modify the system Python. The settings page shows connection errors; prefer Platform, or prepare the local environment manually with the commands above. A better future flow is a guided **environment check + explicit one-click venv creation** in the settings page, rather than automatic execution at plugin install time.

The sidecar reads `oss.llm`, `oss.embedder` and `oss.vector_store` from `mem0ConfigPath` and overrides the collection name with `collectionName`; other Mem0 clients can keep using their own collections.

The sidecar does not inherit DSH's whole environment. It gets `PATH`, `HOME`, locale, proxy and CA-bundle variables, Python/virtualenv/Conda variables, model-cache variables (`HF_*`, `TRANSFORMERS_*`, `TORCH_*` …) and the provider prefixes Mem0 OSS falls back to when `oss.json` has no `api_key` (`OPENAI_*`, `AZURE_*`, `ANTHROPIC_*`, `GOOGLE_*`, `GEMINI_*`, `AWS_*`, `OLLAMA_*`, `DEEPSEEK_*`, `GROQ_*`, `TOGETHER_*`, `MISTRAL_*`, `LITELLM_*`, `QDRANT_*` and similar). `MEM0_API_KEY` and `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` are not passed. If your providers read a variable with another name, list it in `sidecarEnv`. The per-process token is sent on the sidecar's stdin, never as a command-line argument.

**Legacy config locations.** When `mem0ConfigPath` or `pythonPath` is not set, the plugin looks in `~/.dsh/mem0/` first. For setups that predate that folder it then also checks `~/.hermes/mem0.json` and `~/.hermes/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python` (read-only). New installs never need these; set the two options, or move the files into `~/.dsh/mem0/`, to stop using them. The list lives in [lib/legacy-paths.js](lib/legacy-paths.js).

When the sidecar is still starting (first use, or after it crashed), automatic recall skips that turn instead of waiting and the sidecar keeps starting in the background; tools and capture wait for it (startup is bounded at 15 s).
Measured on a hybrid setup (cloud LLM for extraction, local bge-m3 embeddings, local Qdrant). Extraction runs in the cloud, so the local embedding model is what decides whether recall stays fast.

- **Keep the embedding model loaded.** Ollama unloads a model after 5 idle minutes by default. The first recall after a break then waits for a cold load: about 2.5 s for bge-m3 on an i5-13500H, longer when memory is tight. Set `OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=-1` (never unload) or a long value such as `24h` in the environment of the Ollama service. On Windows, add it as a user environment variable, then quit Ollama from the tray and start it again. bge-m3 needs about 1.2 GB of RAM while loaded.
- **`recallTimeoutMs`:** the default is 5000. If the model can still be unloaded (no keep-alive, or memory pressure), use 8000. A recall that times out only skips memories for that turn. Until it finishes, though, the sidecar keeps working on it, so the next recall can time out too.
- **`addTimeoutMs`:** the default 120000 is plenty. With a cloud extraction model, captures took under 10 s in our tests.
- **Embedding model:** keep bge-m3 if you write in Chinese. Smaller English-centric models (`nomic-embed-text`, `all-minilm`) recall Chinese poorly. Switching models also changes the vector size, so it needs a new `collectionName`, and the old memories stay in the old collection.

| Field | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `backend` | `auto` | `auto` / `platform` / `server` / `oss` |
| `apiKey` | empty | Platform or server API key (prefer DSH credentials, see `apiKeyEnv`) |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `MEM0_API_KEY` | Name of the API key in DSH credentials, or of the environment variable |
| `baseUrl` | Platform: `https://api.mem0.ai`; server: `http://127.0.0.1:8888` | API endpoint |
| `authType` | `apiKey` (Platform is fixed to token) | `apiKey` / `bearer` / `token` / `none` |
| `pythonPath` | auto-discovered | OSS-mode Python interpreter |
| `mem0ConfigPath` | `~/.dsh/mem0/oss.json` | OSS-mode Mem0 config file |
| `collectionName` | `dsh_mem0` | OSS-mode Qdrant collection |
| `historyDbPath` | `~/.dsh/mem0/history.db` | OSS sidecar local history database |
| `userId` | `dsh-user` | Memory owner |
| `agentId` | `dsh` | Agent identifier attached on DSH writes; recall currently filters by `userId`, not `agentId` |
| `autoRecall` | `true` | Automatic recall |
| `autoCapture` | `true` | Automatically save completed turns |
| `announceToAgent` | `true` | Announce memory capability to the model |
| `includeSubagents` | `false` | Enable automatic memory for subagents |

Changes saved in the settings page or the profile config apply on their own: the plugin restarts itself when the loader commits new values (`loader/volatile-update`), so no manual reload or DSH restart is needed. With `backend: auto`, storing or removing the key in DSH credentials restarts it too.

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `mem0_search` | Semantic search; returns `[mem0:<id>]` and relevance |
| `mem0_add` | Store one persistent fact verbatim (`infer:false`) |
| `mem0_get` | Read by ID, or list for the configured user; ownership is checked |
| `mem0_update` | Update text by ID; ownership is checked |
| `mem0_delete` | Delete one memory by ID; no bulk delete/reset |
| `mem0_status` | Check backend connection and storage status |
| `mem0_profile_get` | Read the editable memory summary |
| `mem0_profile_update` | Replace memory summary text; empty clears it |
| `mem0_profile_reset` | Rebuild memory summary from stored facts |

```bash
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
npm run check   # node --check on every .js/.mjs/.cjs file
node --test     # tests that need a local port skip with a reason where binding is not allowed

node scripts/smoke-sidecar.mjs

| Backend / feature | Sent | To |
|---|---|---|
| Platform | Captured conversation text (user and assistant messages, redacted and truncated; with `captureStrataFolds`, also redacted dsh-strata fold summaries with metadata `via`, `fold`, `tier`), recall queries, `userId`/`agentId`, metadata `source`, `channel`, `session_id` | `https://api.mem0.ai` (or your `baseUrl`) |
| Server | The same | Your self-hosted Mem0 server |
| OSS | The same, via a loopback-only sidecar | The LLM, embedder and vector store in your `oss.json`; if those are cloud APIs (e.g. OpenAI), the text goes there |
| Memory translation (`translateMemories`, off by default) | Memory text shown on the settings page, up to the full list when the memory browser opens | DSH's current default model, which may be a cloud model |

The working directory is not sent. With `backend: auto`, an inherited `MEM0_API_KEY` alone selects the Platform; check "backend choice" in `mem0_status` or the settings page.

**What is stored locally**

- `<DSH profile>/dsh-mem0/maintenance.json` (mode 0600): the memory summary text and hygiene reports. Reports keep only memory ids, counts and reasons, not the text of deleted memories.
- `<DSH profile>/dsh-mem0/failures.json` (mode 0600): the last 20 memory failures (time, kind, backend, cause, failing component, duration, short message). Messages are redacted and shortened before they are stored: no API keys, tokens, memory text or home-directory paths. Delete the file to clear the history.
- `<DSH profile>/dsh-mem0/sidecar.log` (mode 0600, OSS backend only): the sidecar's stderr plus its start and exit events (exit code or signal, uptime). Each line is redacted before it is written (keys, tokens; home-directory paths shortened to `~`). Capped at 512 KB, with one rotated copy `sidecar.log.1`. Delete both files to clear it.
- `<DSH profile>/dsh-mem0/translation-cache.json` (mode 0600, only when translation is on): memory text and its translation in plain form. Entries are dropped when a memory is deleted through `mem0_delete` or hygiene; memories deleted elsewhere stay until the cache evicts them (2,000 entries max). Delete the file to clear it.
- OSS mode: `historyDbPath` (`~/.ds

- In Platform/server mode, memories are stored by the corresponding service; read that service's privacy and retention policy.
- In OSS mode, memories are stored in the Qdrant/embedder/LLM services you configure.
- `autoCapture` is enabled by default; set it to `false` if you do not want automatic saving. The default `captureFilter: heuristic` only skips clearly low-value turns; common secrets (API keys such as `sk-`, `tvly-`, `AIza…`, JWTs, `Bearer` tokens, passwords in URLs, `password=` / `密码：` phrasing, private keys) are still redacted before writing, but regular expressions are not a substitute for full secret management.
- Weekly hygiene deletes duplicates and over-budget memories written by this plugin, and only after you have confirmed one manual run. Deletion is real and there is no recycle bin; if you want full manual control, set `hygieneEnabled: false`. The profile is still built when missing, but memories are not automatically deleted.
- The sidecar listens only on loopback, with a random port and random token; the token reaches the sidecar on stdin (not visible in `ps`), and the sidecar gets an allowlisted environment rather than all of DSH's; `mem0_status` never retur

- Package name: `dsh-mem0`, `private: false`, with `dsh.bundle` and `dsh-plugin` keywords.
- Marketplace inclusion requires a public GitHub repository, the `dsh-plugin` topic, a repository at least 1 day old, and a `data/plugins/<owner>__<repo>.yml` entry in `awesome-dsh-plugin` with category `memory`.
- The repository is linked through `repository` / `homepage`: `https://github.com/light-cheng/DSH-Mem0`. It includes `screenshots.json` with eight marketplace screenshots, plus localized sets under `assets/screenshots/` (Chinese) and `assets/screenshots/en/` (English). The market reads `screenshots.json` from this repository; only the plugin YAML is submitted to awesome-dsh-plugin.
- The plugin ships a visual settings page (`dsh.client` + `plugins.bundle.config`). A GUI is not required for listing, but this plugin provides one so users can configure all three backends and test the connection right after installation.
- OSS mode depends on external Python/Qdrant/embedding services; the README states this clearly and does not describe the plugin as "zero dependencies".

[English](README.md) | **简体中文**

给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）使用的通用 Mem0 长期记忆插件。 仓库： 支持三种后端： - **Mem0 Platform**：使用 Mem0 托管 API，只需 API Key，适合大多数用户。 - **Self-hosted server**：连接自建 Mem0 REST 服务。 - **OSS Python sidecar**：复用本地 Mem0 Python SDK / Qdrant / embedding 服务，适合本地 bge-m3、Qdrant 等自托管环境。

- **自动召回**：每个回合用最近一条真实用户消息搜索相关记忆，以 `<mem0-relevant-memories>` 数据块注入模型上下文；失败或超时不会阻塞模型请求。
- **自动保存与过滤**：回合正常完成后，把本轮的用户消息和助手的最终回复（不含工具调用之间的中间叙述）交给 Mem0 做事实抽取并写入，工具调用很多的长回合也会被保存；中断、失败、被拒绝的回合不会保存。默认的启发式过滤会跳过问候、简短确认和纯命令回合，减少无价值记忆。
- **可编辑的记忆摘要**：从已存记忆中按置顶/重要度元数据、再按新鲜度（越新越靠前，约 90 天衰减；文本长度只用于平局判定）提取一份结构化摘要，在相关记忆之前注入；它有独立 token 预算，可以直接在设置页编辑，也可以由 agent 通过 `mem0_profile_get` / `mem0_profile_update` / `mem0_profile_reset` 读取或改写。手动编辑不会被周巡检覆盖；「从记忆重建」可恢复自动生成版本。
- **记忆预算与周巡检**：召回记忆和画像各有 token 预算；默认每 7 天做一次记忆卫生巡检，去重并清理超预算中最旧的记忆。巡检只会删除本插件写入的记忆（`metadata.source: "dsh"`），并且在你于设置页确认一次手动巡检之前，自动巡检只出预览、不删除。
- **显式工具**：`mem0_search`、`mem0_add`、`mem0_get`、`mem0_update`、`mem0_delete`、`mem0_status`，以及记忆摘要的 `mem0_profile_get`、`mem0_profile_update`、`mem0_profile_reset`。
- **后端可切换**：Platform、自托管 server、本地 OSS sidecar 共用同一套工具与自动记忆逻辑。
- **可验证的记忆活动**：设置页显示自动保存 / 自动召回的最后状态，列出最近写入的记忆（文本、ID、时间），并可打开「记忆库」搜索当前用户的全部记忆；「上次召回的记忆」显示最近一次召回实际命中的文本。
- **前台状态图标**：对话输入框下方有一个由大小不一的圆点组成的镂空地球仪；自动保存/召回时沿倾斜方向滚动，成功后变成浅蓝色并继续滚动，失败显示红色。滚动时球体轮廓保持圆形，不会压扁。浅色主题下是黑点，深色主题自动用浅色点保证可见。
- **中英双语界面与记忆内容**：文案跟随 DSH 的语言设置；开启 `translateMemories`（默认关闭）后，已存记忆文本会用当前 DSH 模型翻译成页面语言，带缓存，没有可用模型时回退原文。
- **安全边界**：sidecar 只监听 `127.0.0.1` 的随机端口并使用随机 token；写入/召回

安装后打开 DSH 侧栏的「插件」页，在「已安装插件」中打开「Mem0 长期记忆」，即可直接在 Bundle 详情里选择后端、查看实时连接状态并保存设置：

支持三种后端，每种都有对应的字段和引导：

页面里的「测试连接」会调用 `mem0_status` 同源的只读健康检查，显示当前后端、集合、Python/Mem0/Qdrant/Embedder 状态，不会显示 API Key。

「记忆摘要」是召回时优先注入的可编辑摘要，按主题分节显示；点「编辑摘要」修改并保存，下一轮对话即可使用；「从记忆重建」会丢弃手动编辑，按已存记忆重新生成。

「记忆活动」会记录最近一次自动保存和自动召回的结果；「最近写入的记忆」直接读取后端，显示真实记忆文本、ID 和时间。这样不需要猜自动保存有没有生效。自动保存执行了但没有写入任何记忆（新增、更新、删除都是 0）时，徽章是灰色的「无新内容」而不是绿色的「已保存」，状态栏显示「无新内容可记」；Platform、server 后端的回应里没有计数时，仍显示「已保存」：

「查看全部记忆」会打开「记忆库」，可按记忆内容或 ID 搜索当前用户存储的全部记忆。本插件写入的记忆（`metadata.source = "dsh"`）有「删除」按钮：先显示这条记忆的完整内容和 ID 并要求确认，确认后才删除这一条，同时清掉它的译文缓存并刷新列表。其他应用写入的记忆、属于其他 Mem0 用户的记忆不显示按钮，插件的路由（`DELETE /dsh-mem0/gui/memories?id=…`）也会以 HTTP 403 拒绝并说明原因。不提供批量删除、清空全部或按条件删除。「上次召回的记忆」显示最近一次自动召回实际命中的文本、ID、条数和延迟：

「记忆维护」区域可以调整记忆摘要预算、召回预算、存储上限和巡检间隔，并查看上次/下次巡检时间、最近一次巡检报告（扫描、重复、预算清理、删除、失败数量，以及运行时间和触发方式）和当前记忆摘要规模；「立即巡检」会先生成预览并提示「将删除 N 条」，确认后才清理本插件写入的重复项与超预算记忆，不会覆盖手动编辑的记忆摘要：

对话输入框下方还会显示点阵地球仪：待命时静止，记录中沿倾斜方向滚动，成功后变成浅蓝色并继续滚动。滚动使用三维投影，点阵球体的轮廓保持圆形，不会压扁或变形；系统开启「减少动态效果」时保持静止。

实际会话底部的状态条（截取）：

「测试连接」成功时，状态卡会显示绿色的「连接成功」：

英文界面（跟随 DSH 语言设置）：

设置页的「记忆维护」区域把几个容易混淆的预算分开：

- **记忆摘要预算**：`<mem0-user-profile>` 数据块的上限，默认 1375 tokens。
- **召回记忆预算**：`<mem0-relevant-memories>` 数据块的上限，默认 2200 tokens。
- **存储上限**：巡检后保留的最大记忆条数（默认 500）和估算 tokens（默认 20000）。

巡检默认每 7 天一次，可改成 1–90 天；插件启动时若已到期会跑一次，之后每小时检查一次。巡检只删除重复项和超预算中最旧的记忆，并且只在本插件写入的记忆（自动保存和 `mem0_add` 会写入 `metadata.source: "dsh"`）里挑选；同一 `userId` 下其他应用写入的记忆会参与摘要，但绝不删除，也不计入存储上限。在你确认过一次手动「立即巡检」之前，自动巡检都是预览：报告标明「预览，未删除」并列出将删除的记忆，不做任何删除。每次巡检最多删除 100 条。不会清空整个库；画像和巡检历史保存在当前 DSH profile 的 `dsh-mem0/maintenance.json`，不写回 Mem0。最近一次报告会持续显示在「记忆维护」卡片中，包括扫描、重复、预算清理、删除和失败数量、运行时间与触发方式；手动「立即巡检」也会返回同一组数量。

自动生成的记忆摘要由本地确定性逻辑生成，不额外调用模型；你可以随时手动编辑，内容保存在 `maintenance.json`，不会被巡检覆盖。点「从记忆重建」可恢复自动生成版本。分节标题跟随记忆的主要语言：多数记忆是中文时用中文，否则用英文。

为了让 DeepSeek 的前缀缓存持续命中，记忆摘要作为系统提示词分段（`plugin:dsh-mem0:profile`）注入，只在已保存的摘要变化时才变；每轮变化的 `<mem0-relevant-memories>` 召回块作为运行时上下文（`mem0:recall`），由 DSH 追加在最新一条用户消息旁边，不会改写之前的历史。

上下文管理插件（例如 dsh-strata）可以通过下面的名字和标记识别 DSH-Mem0 注入的内容。这些名字和标记跨版本保持不变；改动任何一个都算不兼容变更，由 `test/interop-contract.test.js` 把关。

| 内容 | 放在哪里 | 名字 | 文本开头 / 结尾 | 变化频率 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 记忆摘要 | 系统提示段 | `plugin:dsh-mem0:profile` | `<mem0-user-profile>` … `</mem0-user-profile>` | 只在已存摘要变化时 |
| 召回的记忆 | 运行时上下文，总在最后 | `mem0:recall` | `<mem0-relevant-memories>` … `</mem0-relevant-memories>` | 通常每轮都变 |

- DSH 把所有运行时上下文拼成一个快照；只要拼接后的文本有变化，就把它作为 user 角色消息（`source.kind: "runtime-context"`）追加到历史。旧快照会留在历史里，其中的召回块已经过时：上下文插件可以直接裁掉或丢弃它们，不需要模型摘要，也不需要保留原文，因为 Mem0 随时可以重新召回。最新的那个快照不要动。
- 这个快照不是用户输入。自动保存只读取来源为 `user` 的 `user/message` 事件，所以召回块不会被再写回 Mem0。
- 自动保存在 `turn/end` 时进行，用的是 DSH-Mem0 从本轮事件里缓存的文本（用户消息和助手的最终回复），不读会话历史，也不读工具输出。所以无论在保存之前还是之后，回合结束时裁剪历史都不会改变保存的内容。
- 召回块里的记忆文本会去掉伪造的块标记，每个块只有一对开头和结尾标记。
同时安装 [dsh-strata](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lightcheng/dsh-strata) 时，两个插件按一份共同约定配合：

- **共用召回预算。** 每次召回前，DSH-Mem0 向 Strata 的可选服务 `strataBudget` 询问本轮召回块最多能用多少 token：平时是完整的 `memoryBudgetTokens`；上下文超过 65%（`tight`）时减半；超过 75%（`critical`）时最多 512。额度为 0 时本轮不召回。召回块用 Strata 的 token 计数（和它的阈值同一套）来裁剪。没装 Strata，或者服务出错、返回不可用的值时，召回照旧使用 `memoryBudgetTokens`。记忆摘要不按轮缩减：它在有缓存的系统提示里，每轮改动的代价比省下的 token 更大。`mem0_status` 和「最近活动」卡片会显示上一次的预算，例如 `recall budget 1100 / 2200 (strata: tight)`。
- **折叠摘要作为记忆来源（`captureStrataFolds`，默认关闭）。** 打开它并且开启自动保存时，Strata 每落地一份一级折叠摘要（`strata/fold-landed`，只处理 tier 1，只处理主代理会话），就脱敏后经同一个保存队列写入 Mem0，metadata 为 `source: "dsh"`、`via: "dsh-strata"`、`fold`、`tier`、`session_id`，所以巡检会像对待其他自动保存一样处理它。这些回合已经被自动保存过一次，这里是同一段内容的第二份、更干净的摘要；重复的事实由 Mem0 自己的推理合并。空的或价值低的摘要会被跳过。召回块不会进入 Strata 的归档，Strata 会直接丢弃过时的召回快照，不会折叠它们。

```text
DSH Agent
  ├─ system-prompt/assemble ──┐
  ├─ session/event            ├─> Node 插件（index.js + lib/）
  ├─ mem0_* tools            ─┘        │

通过 DSH Plugin Manager 安装本目录（开发/本地安装）：

```text
plugin_manager action: install_bundle
target: <本目录的绝对路径>
```

也可以用 DSH CLI：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:"$(pwd)"
```

发布到 npm 后可以按包名安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-mem0
```

安装后如果提示 `restart-required`，重启 DSH 后再验证。

> 本地 `link:` 安装时，DSH 插件详情页的「代码来源」会显示本机 checkout 路径。这是本地 profile 的安装元数据，不是插件包内容；`npm pack` 和从 npm 安装的包不包含本机路径，从 npm 安装会显示包来源。发布用的截图已避开这一行。

安装后可以直接在 DSH 侧栏「插件」页的「Mem0 长期记忆」Bundle 详情中可视化配置（推荐）；也可以手写 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`。完整 YAML 示例：

```yaml
- id: dsh-mem0
  name: dsh-mem0
  config:
    backend: platform

```yaml
config:
  backend: platform
  apiKey: "your-platform-api-key"
  userId: "your-user-id"

API Key 不必写进插件配置。推荐存到 DSH 凭据里（例如 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`），这样它不会出现在 profile 配置中：

```yaml
version: 1
refs:
  MEM0_API_KEY: m0-your-key
```

然后按名字引用（这也是默认值）：

```yaml
config:
  backend: platform
  apiKeyEnv: MEM0_API_KEY
```

查找顺序：配置里的 `apiKey` → DSH 凭据里 `apiKeyEnv` 指定的名字（先查凭据文件，再查启动环境和 `.env` 文件）→ 同名环境变量。使用凭据时，更换 Key 后下一次请求就会生效，不用重启。`mem0_status` 会显示 Key 的来源（`key source: config`、`credentials`、`env` 或 `none`），不显示 Key 本身。

> **关于 `backend: auto`：** 只要 DSH 凭据或 DSH 的环境变量里有 `MEM0_API_KEY`（或 `apiKeyEnv` 指定的名字），`auto` 就会选择云端 Platform，即使本地有 OSS 配置。`mem0_status` 和设置页会显示「后端选择依据」。想用特定后端请明确设置 `backend`。

```yaml
config:
  backend: server
  baseUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:8888"
  authType: apiKey

`authType` 支持 `apiKey`（`X-API-Key`）、`bearer`、`token` 和 `none`（`AUTH_DISABLED=true` 的本地服务）。

readme.section: OSS Python sidecar（本地 Qdrant / bge-m3）
readme.text:
先准备一个 Mem0 OSS 配置文件，例如 `~/.dsh/mem0/oss.json`，格式见 [examples/oss-config.example.json](examples/oss-config.example.json)。

```yaml
config:
  backend: oss
  pythonPath: "~/.dsh/mem0/venv/bin/python"
  mem0ConfigPath: "~/.dsh/mem0/oss.json"

Python 环境需要：

```bash
python3 -m venv ~/.dsh/mem0/venv
~/.dsh/mem0/venv/bin/pip install "mem0ai>=2.0.10,<3" qdrant-client openai
```

readme.section: OSS Python sidecar（本地 Qdrant / bge-m3）
readme.text:
当前版本**不会在插件加载时静默安装** Python 或 Qdrant，也不会修改系统 Python。设置页会显示连接错误；建议优先使用 Platform，或按上面的命令手动准备本地环境。后续更合适的做法是在设置页做「环境检测 + 用户点击后一键创建 venv」的引导安装，而不是安装插件时自动执行。

sidecar 会读取 `mem0ConfigPath` 中的 `oss.llm`、`oss.embedder`、`oss.vector_store`，并把集合名覆盖为 `collectionName`；其他 Mem0 客户端可以继续使用自己的集合。

readme.section: OSS Python sidecar（本地 Qdrant / bge-m3）
readme.text: sidecar 不继承 DSH 的全部环境变量，只拿到：`PATH`、`HOME`、语言区域、代理和 CA 证书相关变量，Python/virtualenv/Conda 变量，模型缓存变量（`HF_*`、`TRANSFORMERS_*`、`TORCH_*` 等），以及 `oss.json` 没写 `api_key` 时 Mem0 OSS 会去读的各家服务商前缀（`OPENAI_*`、`AZURE_*`、`ANTHROPIC_*`、`GOOGLE_*`、`GEMINI_*`、`AWS_*`、`OLLAMA_*`、`DEEPSEEK_*`、`GROQ_*`、`TOGETHER_*`、`MISTRAL_*`、`LITELLM_*`、`QDRANT_*` 等）。`MEM0_API_KEY` 和 `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` 不会传过去。如果你的服务商读取别的变量名，把它写进 `sidecarEnv`。每个进程的 token 通过 sidecar 的 stdin 传入，不出现在命令行参数里。

readme.section: OSS Python sidecar（本地 Qdrant / bge-m3）
readme.text:
**旧版配置位置。** 没有设置 `mem0ConfigPath` 或 `pythonPath` 时，插件先找 `~/.dsh/mem0/`；为了兼容早于这个目录的旧环境，接着还会（只读地）检查 `~/.hermes/mem0.json` 和 `~/.hermes/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python`。新安装用不到这些路径；设置这两个配置项，或把文件移到 `~/.dsh/mem0/`，就不会再用它们。完整列表在 [lib/legacy-paths.js](lib/legacy-paths.js)。

sidecar 还在启动时（第一次使用，或崩溃后重启），自动召回会直接跳过这一轮、不等待，sidecar 在后台继续启动；工具调用和自动保存会等它启动完成（启动最多 15 秒）。

readme.section: 低配机器（embedding 只能用 CPU 跑）
readme.text: 下面的数字来自混合方案的实测：记忆抽取用云端 LLM，embedding 用本地 bge-m3，Qdrant 也在本地。抽取在云端完成，所以召回快不快，主要看本地 embedding 模型。

readme.section: 低配机器（embedding 只能用 CPU 跑）
readme.text:
- **让 embedding 模型常驻内存。** Ollama 默认在模型空闲 5 分钟后把它卸载。停一会儿再用时，第一次召回要等模型冷加载：在 i5-13500H 上 bge-m3 大约要 2.5 秒，内存紧张时更久。在 Ollama 服务的环境变量里设置 `OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=-1`（永不卸载），或一个较长的值，例如 `24h`。Windows 上把它加为用户环境变量，然后从托盘退出 Ollama 再重新打开。bge-m3 加载后约占 1.2 GB 内存。
- **`recallTimeoutMs`：** 默认 5000。如果模型仍可能被卸载（没设 keep-alive，或内存紧张），建议设成 8000。召回超时只会让这一轮不带记忆；但 sidecar 会把这次请求做完，在它做完之前，下一次召回也可能跟着超时。
- **`addTimeoutMs`：** 默认 120000 足够。抽取用云端模型时，测试里每次保存都在 10 秒以内完成。
- **embedding 模型：** 用中文的话保留 bge-m3。更小的、以英文为主的模型（`nomic-embed-text`、`all-minilm`）召回中文效果差。换模型还会改变向量维度，需要换一个新的 `collectionName`，旧记忆留在旧 collection 里。

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `backend` | `auto` | `auto` / `platform` / `server` / `oss` |
| `apiKey` | 空 | Platform 或 server 的 API Key（建议改用 DSH 凭据，见 `apiKeyEnv`） |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `MEM0_API_KEY` | API Key 在 DSH 凭据里的名字，或环境变量名 |
| `baseUrl` | Platform 为 `https://api.mem0.ai`，server 为 `http://127.0.0.1:8888` | API 地址 |
| `authType` | `apiKey`（platform 固定 token） | `apiKey` / `bearer` / `token` / `none` |
| `pythonPath` | 自动发现 | OSS 模式 Python 解释器 |
| `mem0ConfigPath` | `~/.dsh/mem0/oss.json` | OSS 模式 Mem0 配置文件 |
| `collectionName` | `dsh_mem0` | OSS 模式 Qdrant 集合 |
| `historyDbPath` | `~/.dsh/mem0/history.db` | OSS sidecar 本地历史库 |
| `userId` | `dsh-user` | 记忆归属用户 |
| `agentId` | `dsh` | DSH 写入时附加的 agent 标识；当前召回只按 `userId` 过滤，不按 `agentId` 隔离 |
| `autoRecall` | `true` | 自动召回 |
| `autoCapture` | `true` | 自动保存完成回合 |
| `announceToAgent` | `true` | 向模型宣告记忆能力 |
| `includeSubagents` | `false` | 是否对子代理启用自动记忆 |
| `captureMaxChars` | `450` | 自动保存时每条消息截断上限 |
| `captureFilter` | `heuristic` | `heuristic` 跳过低价值回合；`off` 保存每个完成回合 |
| `recallTopK` | `5` | 自动召回结果数 |
| `memoryBudgetTokens` | `2200` | 召回记忆块的 token 上限，128–20000。这就是实际上限（中文约 1 字 1 token，英文约 4 字符 1 token），没有更小的字符上限 |
| `profileEnabled` |
在设置页或 profile 配置里保存的修改会自动生效：loader 提交新配置时（`loader/volatile-update`）插件会自己重启，不需要手动重新加载插件或重启 DSH。`backend: auto` 下，在 DSH 凭据里存入或删除 Key 也会让插件重启。

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `mem0_search` | 语义搜索，返回 `[mem0:<id>]` 和相关度 |
| `mem0_add` | 原样存储一条持久事实（`infer:false`） |
| `mem0_get` | 按 id 读取，或按配置用户列出；会校验归属 |
| `mem0_update` | 按 id 更新文本；会校验归属 |
| `mem0_delete` | 按 id 删除单条；不提供批量删除/reset |
| `mem0_status` | 检查后端连接和存储状态 |
| `mem0_profile_get` | 读取可编辑的记忆摘要 |
| `mem0_profile_update` | 替换记忆摘要文本；空字符串表示清空 |
| `mem0_profile_reset` | 按已存事实重建记忆摘要 |

```bash
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
npm run check   # 对所有 .js/.mjs/.cjs 文件做 node --check
node --test     # 需要本地端口的测试在不允许监听的环境里会跳过并说明原因

readme.section: Python 测试：配置构建和 HTTP 处理器（用假 service，不需要安装 mem0ai）
readme.text:
PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX="$PWD/.pycache" \
  python3 -m unittest discover -s python/tests -v

**哪些数据会离开本机**

| 后端 / 功能 | 发送内容 | 发往 |
|---|---|---|
| Platform | 捕获的对话文本（用户和助手消息，已脱敏并截断；开启 `captureStrataFolds` 时还有脱敏后的 dsh-strata 折叠摘要，元数据带 `via`、`fold`、`tier`）、召回查询、`userId`/`agentId`、元数据 `source`、`channel`、`session_id` | `https://api.mem0.ai`（或你的 `baseUrl`） |
| Server | 同上 | 你自建的 Mem0 服务器 |
| OSS | 同上，经由只监听 loopback 的 sidecar | `oss.json` 里配置的 LLM、embedder 和向量库；如果它们是云端 API（如 OpenAI），文本会发到那里 |
| 记忆翻译（`translateMemories`，默认关闭） | 设置页上显示的记忆原文，打开记忆库时最多是整个列表 | DSH 当前默认模型，可能是云端模型 |

不会发送工作目录。`backend: auto` 下，仅凭继承来的 `MEM0_API_KEY` 就会选择 Platform；可在 `mem0_status` 或设置页查看「后端选择依据」。

**哪些数据保存在本地**

- `<DSH profile>/dsh-mem0/maintenance.json`（权限 0600）：记忆摘要文本和巡检报告。报告只保留记忆 id、数量和原因，不保留被删记忆的文本。
- `<DSH profile>/dsh-mem0/failures.json`（权限 0600）：最近 20 次记忆失败（时间、类型、后端、原因、出错组件、耗时、简短消息）。消息在保存前脱敏并截短，不含 API key、token、记忆正文和用户主目录路径。删除该文件即可清空。
- `<DSH profile>/dsh-mem0/sidecar.log`（权限 0600，仅 OSS 后端）：sidecar 的 stderr，以及它每次启动、退出的事件（退出码或信号、运行时长）。每行写入前先脱敏（密钥、token；家目录路径换成 `~`）。上限 512 KB，另保留一份轮转的 `sidecar.log.1`。删除这两个文件即可清空。
- `<DSH profile>/dsh-mem0/translation-cache.json`（权限 0600，仅在开启翻译时产生）：记忆原文和译文明文。通过 `mem0_delete` 或巡检删除记忆时会同步删除对应条目；在别处删除的记忆会留到缓存淘汰为止（最多 2000 条）。删除该文件即可清空。
- OSS 模式：`historyDbPath`（`~/.dsh/mem0/history.db`）以及你 OSS 环境里的 Qdrant 数据。

- Platform/server 模式的记忆由对应服务保存；请阅读服务方的隐私和保留策略。
- OSS 模式的记忆保存在你配置的 Qdrant/embedder/LLM 服务中。
- `autoCapture` 默认开启；如果不希望自动保存，请显式设为 `false`。默认的 `captureFilter: heuristic` 只跳过明显的低价值回合；写入前仍会做常见密钥脱敏（`sk-`、`tvly-`、`AIza…` 等 API Key、JWT、`Bearer` 令牌、URL 里的密码、`password=` / `密码：` 写法、私钥），但正则表达式不能替代完整的 secret 管理。
- 周巡检会删除本插件写入的重复项和超预算记忆，且只在你确认过一次手动巡检之后才会自动删除。删除是真实删除，不会进入回收站；如果希望完全手动控制，可设 `hygieneEnabled: false`，此时仍会在画像缺失时构建画像，但不会自动删除记忆。
- sidecar 只监听 loopback，随机端口 + 随机 token；token 通过 stdin 传给 sidecar（`ps` 看不到），sidecar 只拿到白名单内的环境变量，而不是 DSH 的全部环境；`mem0_status` 不返回 API key。

- 包名：`dsh-mem0`，`private: false`，已带 `dsh.bundle` 与 `dsh-plugin` 关键词。
- 市场收录需要公开 GitHub 仓库、`dsh-plugin` topic、仓库创建满 1 天，并在 `awesome-dsh-plugin` 提交一个 `data/plugins/<owner>__<repo>.yml`，分类选 `memory`。
- 仓库已绑定 `repository` / `homepage`：`https://github.com/light-cheng/DSH-Mem0`。仓库根目录的 `screenshots.json` 提供 8 张市场截图，另有 `assets/screenshots/`（中文）和 `assets/screenshots/en/`（英文）两套界面图。市场直接读取本仓库的 `screenshots.json`；提交到 awesome-dsh-plugin 的只有插件 YAML。
- 插件自带可视化配置页（`dsh.client` + `plugins.bundle.config`），上架不要求 GUI，但本插件已提供，便于用户安装后直接配置三种后端并测试连接。
- OSS 模式依赖外部 Python/Qdrant/embedding 服务，README 已明确声明，不应描述成“零依赖”插件。
